w10_T4_002625: A village cheese shop had 101 small wheels of cheese in its cellar. The owner threw away 6 wheels that had gone mouldy. A dairy delivered 68 more wheels the following week. A restaurant then bought 78 wheels, a hotel took 12, and a market stall carried off another 71. Each wheel still in the cellar will be cut into 5 portions, and half of the cellar shelves now stand empty. How many portions will the shop have?
w10_T4_002637: In the morning Elias filled 9 crates with 30 apples in each crate. The whole pile was divided into 2 equal shares, and one share went to the juice press while the other stayed in the barn. In the afternoon every apple left in the barn was cut into 4 slices for the drying racks. His neighbour Farida added 33 slices of her own, far fewer than Elias had prepared. In the evening the family ate 37 slices straight off the racks. The farm weighs its fruit in kilograms rather than in grams. How many apple slices were left on the drying racks?
w10_T4_002647: The bus depot logs its driving in minutes rather than in hours. Each day one bus covers 3 routes that take 166 minutes apiece, and 26 minutes of depot shunting are added on top of that. The same pattern was repeated on each of the 9 days of the roadworks. All of those minutes were then shared equally between the 2 drivers who cover that bus. How many minutes did one driver spend on the bus?
w10_T4_002648: A stationery shop started the week with 45 notebooks and took in 58 more on Monday. A second delivery on Tuesday doubled the number of notebooks in the shop. The owner threw out 14 notebooks with torn covers, and a school returned 51 unused ones. Every notebook in the shop was then sold for 5 dollars, and the till is counted in dollars rather than in cents. The shop's costs for the week came to 608 dollars. How many dollars did the shop have left once those costs were paid?
w10_T4_002649: A hotel storeroom held 102 boxes of candles, and a delivery added 30 more boxes. Every box in the room contains 7 candles. A dozen guests waited in the lobby while the porter counted them. He then found 76 loose candles on a shelf and added them to the count. Each candle burns for 4 hours, and the hotel records burn times in hours rather than in minutes. An emergency lamp gives another 57 hours of light. How many hours of light does the hotel have in total?
w10_T4_002657: A school kitchen had 33 crates of milk and ordered 20 more for the new term. 6 of the crates arrived leaking and were sent straight back. The kitchen has 4 large fridges along the wall. Every crate the kitchen kept holds 6 cartons, and a cook found 38 loose cartons in the store cupboard and added them in. Each carton pours 2 cups, because the kitchen measures its milk in cups rather than in litres. How many cups of milk does the kitchen have?
w10_T4_002660: On Saturday morning a stadium kiosk had 214 pretzels ready in the warmer. A van delivered 58 more before the gates opened. In the first half hour the staff gave 31 pretzels to the volunteers for nothing. Every pretzel that the kiosk still had was sold for 5 dollars. In the evening the kiosk also took 60 dollars from coffee sales. How many dollars did the kiosk take altogether?
w10_T4_002664: On Monday morning a print works started 7 machines, and each machine produced 103 posters every hour. The machines ran for 4 hours before lunch, and all the posters went into one stack. In the afternoon 48 posters left over from Friday were added to that stack. That evening a courier collected 2113 posters from it. A leaking roof then ruined 181 more posters overnight. The works logs its machine time in minutes rather than in hours. How many posters are left in the stack?
w10_T4_002666: Hassan filled 201 sandbags on the first day and exactly the same number on the second, so 2 days of his work went into the pile. His neighbour Lucia added 79 sandbags and a council lorry brought 78 more, so Lucia's contribution was far smaller than Hassan's. Each sandbag in the pile holds 3 buckets of sand. Every bucket of sand weighs 4 kilograms. The flood defence used up 1647 kilograms of that sand. How many kilograms of sand are left?
w10_T4_002670: On Monday morning a dairy filled 3 tanks with 212 litres of milk in each tank. Before noon a farmer added 29 litres to the same store. In the afternoon a cheesemaker collected 286 litres. Every litre still at the dairy is poured into 4 small bottles, and the dairy counts its stock in bottles rather than in litres. In the evening a delivery round took 908 bottles into town. How many bottles were left at the dairy?
w10_T4_002677: Beatriz had 78 chairs stacked in the village hall, and Marco brought 12 more, a much smaller load than hers. Every chair in the hall is fitted with 7 bolts. A box holding 34 spare bolts sits under the stage. The caretaker found another 32 bolts in a drawer behind the door. How many bolts are in the hall altogether?
w10_T4_002683: A community pantry started the month with 140 tins of soup. A supermarket donated 69 tins, and a church collection brought in 74 more. Every tin holds 5 servings, and the pantry counts its stock in servings rather than in tins. Over the winter 1369 servings were handed out, and half of those went to families with young children. How many servings are left in the pantry?
w10_T4_002684: Ruth had 204 rolls of wallpaper in her lock-up. Her business partner Callum added 50 rolls, and a clearance sale brought in 38 more, so Callum's share was far smaller than what Ruth had started with. A hotel refurbishment then used 261 rolls. Each roll still in the lock-up covers 5 square metres, and Ruth measures her jobs in square metres rather than in square feet. How many square metres can the remaining rolls cover?
w10_T4_002691: A bottling plant filled 178 crates on the morning shift and exactly the same number again on the night shift, so 2 shifts stocked the store. A wholesaler returned 58 crates the next day. Every crate in the store holds 2 boxes, and each box holds 4 bottles. The plant employs 90 people. A supervisor found 65 loose bottles on the loading bay and added them to the count. Each bottle pours 3 cups, and the plant reports its output in cups rather than in litres. How many cups can the store pour?
w10_T4_002692: A scout camp shared 80 logs equally among its 4 campfires. The leaders then added 5 more logs to the fire by the lake. Every log on that fire burns for 3 hours. The campsite is 7 kilometres from the village shop. For each hour a fire burns, the troop uses 5 fire lighters from the store. How many fire lighters will the fire by the lake use?
w10_T4_002699: Sofia's nursery raised 178 seedlings in each of its 8 greenhouses. Every one of those seedlings produced 7 cuttings. Her assistant Dan contributed 61 cuttings from his own bench, far fewer than Sofia had raised. The nursery runs 3 delivery vans and lists its growing times in weeks rather than in months. A garden chain bought 5138 cuttings, and 623 more failed to root. A customer later returned 49 cuttings that had arrived too late to plant. How many cuttings does the nursery still have?
w10_T4_002702: Early on Monday morning a warehouse shared 192 rolls of ribbon equally among its 6 gift-wrapping stations. Later that morning 79 more rolls were delivered to the first station. In the afternoon 18 rolls at that station were used up and thrown away. Every roll still at the first station is 9 metres long. How many metres of ribbon does the first station have?
w10_T4_002706: Nadir had 44 sheets of coloured card and used 19 of them on a wall display. Each sheet that was left can be cut into 7 name badges. His colleague Priya made 49 badges of her own, which was fewer than Nadir cut from his card. The staffroom has 16 chairs around the table. For the second open evening the school tripled the number of badges it was holding. How many badges did the school have then?
w10_T4_002710: A courier depot had 148 parcels at dawn, and a rival firm collected 59 of them. A morning shipment then doubled the number of parcels still in the depot. A shop dropped off 57 more parcels before noon. Every parcel in the depot weighs 9 pounds, and the depot records its loads in pounds rather than in tons. What is the total weight, in pounds, of the parcels in the depot?
w10_T4_002711: A market gardener sowed 41 rows of beans, but 21 of the rows failed in the drought. Each surviving row holds 4 plants. Every one of those plants produced 9 pods this summer. A neighbour gave the gardener 77 more pods from her own plot. The gardener's shed is 12 years old. She sold 343 pods at the Saturday market. How many pods does she still have?
w10_T4_002712: On Saturday morning Ines baked 33 loaves, and her partner Otto baked exactly the same number, so 2 equal batches sat on the bench. The loaves were loaded equally into 2 vans, and the first van drove to the market. In the afternoon each loaf in that van was cut into 6 tasting slices. Otto then brought over a tray of 33 more slices, fewer than Ines had cut. The stall laid out that same spread of slices on each of its 3 tasting tables. By closing time 515 slices had been eaten. How many slices were left?
w10_T4_002714: A school had 63 laptops in the cupboard at the start of term. 4 of them had cracked screens and were sent away for repair. The IT teacher lent 48 laptops to the exam hall for the week. The school hall seats 300 people. Each laptop still in the cupboard has 9 software licences installed on it. The office then cancelled 73 of those licences to save money. How many licences are left on the cupboard laptops?
w10_T4_002715: Ravi's stall began the fair with 153 balloons, and his helper Meera brought 6 more, a much smaller bundle than Ravi's. He sold 68 balloons before lunch and gave 45 away to a nursery group. A sponsor then delivered 77 balloons to the stall. Meera's brother arrived at teatime with another 22. How many balloons did the stall have?
w10_T4_002717: A print shop had 224 sheets of card in the store, a supplier added 20 sheets, and a school donated 44 more. All of the sheets were then shared equally among the 6 workshop tables. The first table later received 70 extra sheets from a cancelled order. The workshop building has 9 windows along its front. The shop counts its card in single sheets rather than in reams. How many sheets are on the first table?
w10_T4_002719: A hotel has 187 rooms in the main wing and 37 more in the annexe. Every one of those rooms is stocked with 5 towels. The linen store holds double the number of towels that are out in the rooms. A guest returned 13 towels that had been packed by mistake, and they went into the store as well. Each towel in the store is washed 8 times over the summer season. How many washes is that altogether?
